name: Jordi Escayola
bio: Jordi Escayola is a global AI and data science leader in the pharma industry. With more than twenty years deploying AI in some of the most complex sectors in the world, he has led over eighty large-scale projects across financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail and the public sector. He holds advanced degrees in mathematics and statistics and an executive MBA, and teaches at universities including EAE and La Salle.
